description: The control for memory-lesson-chain: the same seed and fix round, then .planning/memory/ is removed before phase 2 runs. Reports whether phase 2's code rejects a bad name anyway.
why: Memory optimisation O6. Without a control, phase 2 validating its argument could be the model's habit or an imitation of the fixed greet.js rather than the lesson. Everything here matches the chain except that no lesson can reach phase 2.

steps.why: Same starting ledger as the chain.
Same fix round as the chain.
The one difference: no memory reaches phase 2.
The next phase, without the lesson.
No lesson was injected; `effect.validates` here is the base rate the chain is compared with.
Working code: the seed's tests pass after both phases.
